ic.definition: All acceptance criteria AC1-AC9 of Jira ANA-40 (ticket text binding; summaries below are excerpts) are implemented in workers/instagram-oauth, and each AC has at least one automated node:test test with exact expected values, named in docs/evidence/ANA-40/CHECKLIST.md; every new test was seen failing once (docs/evidence/ANA-40/RED-RUNS.md). AC10 is Production Verified after merge, not IC. AC1 the existing cron 0 5 * * * runs exactly one check per run with at most 1 Meta call, no new trigger: expires_at <= now -> REAUTH_REQUIRED (EXPIRED), no Meta call; refresh due (>= 24 h old, <= 15 days left) -> only the existing refresh; only when refresh() reports NOT_DUE -> GET /{GRAPH_VERSION}/me?fields=user_id via metaFetch, accepted when user_id is a digit string equal to EXPECTED_IG_USER_ID. AC2 code 190 from /me or refresh, or expires_at <= now, yields REAUTH_REQUIRED and connected:false after the next cron run. AC3 every other non-OK result (timeout, network error, HTTP 5xx, non-JSON, rate limit 4/17/32/613, code 10/200, other codes, missing or different user_id, invalid refresh payload) is UNVERIFIABLE with an error class and never changes connection_status; after 36 h without OK the read status is UNVERIFIED, never REAUTH_REQUIRED. AC4 GET /admin/status, evaluated in this order: no row -> NOT_AUTHORIZED, connected:false; D1 REAUTH_REQUIRED or expires_at <= now -> REAUTH_REQUIRED, false; last_health_ok_at null or now - last_health_ok_at >= 129600 s -> UNVERIFIED, false; else CONNECTED, true; plus health {scope:'basic-token-and-account-id', last_check_at, last_check_result OK|TOKEN_INVALID|EXPIRED|UNVERIFIABLE, last_check_error_class, last_ok_at, last_ok_source callback|cron|refresh, fresh_until = last_ok_at + 129600 or null}; the limitation (base token validity and account id only; media, insights and permissions are not confirmed, /admin/probe and /admin/insights-probe remain for that) is documented; error classes carry no token, OAuth code or URL; existing last_refresh_* fields keep their meaning. AC5 connected:true only for D1 CONNECTED with last_health_ok_at > now - 36 h (exactly 36 h = UNVERIFIED, missed cron included); UNVERIFIED is computed on read and never stored in connection_status. AC6 a successful OAuth callback (in the existing D1 batch, insert and ON CONFLICT paths) and a successful refresh (cron or POST /admin/refresh, in the same UPDATE that rotates the ciphertext) make /admin/status CONNECTED immediately with fresh last_ok_at and source callback or refresh, without an extra Meta call. AC7 every health and status write is bound to the token_ciphertext of the row read for the check; a result for the old token (190, OK or not checkable) never changes status or health fields of a concurrently re-authorized token. AC8 the twelve cases of ticket AC8 run in npm run check over the real migration SQL incl. 0002 (the test D1 applies every migrations/*.sql in order). AC9 no new permission, public endpoint, secret or Cloudflare resource except migration 0002 in the existing D1 database; logs carry no token, OAuth code, URL or query string. Clarifications, confirmed by the PO on 2026-10-21 ((a) renames the ticket's 190 result REVOKED to TOKEN_INVALID; otherwise ticket wording and today's behaviour are kept): (a) classification uses the integer error.code from getMetaJson: code 190 means REAUTH_REQUIRED with last_check_result TOKEN_INVALID (not REVOKED, because the reason for the token being invalid is not reliably known) whatever the HTTP status, so 'HTTP 5xx' in AC3 means 5xx without code 190 (unchanged refresh rule); (b) a row already D1 REAUTH_REQUIRED and not expired gets no Meta call in the cron and its health fields stay as they are (existing invariant 'a REAUTH_REQUIRED token is never sent to Meta again'); (c) a successful callback or refresh also sets last_check_at=now, last_check_result OK and last_check_error_class null. Not in scope (ticket NOT_WHAT): no status change in /admin/probe, /admin/insights-probe, /internal/media or /internal/social-snapshot; usableToken() keeps reading only connection_status; no Meta subcode stored; codes 10/200 never set REAUTH_REQUIRED; no Meta call in /admin/status, no higher frequency, no external monitor; no dashboard, Meta app or scope change.

r2g.definition: On the exact candidate SHA (base = merge-base with origin/main, today c7b2c06), each result recorded with command, exit code and SHA in a Jira ANA-40 comment: (1) GitHub Actions workflow 'worker-instagram' green (npm ci, npm run check over the real migration SQL incl. 0002). (2) GitHub Actions workflow 'drs' green; the implementation PR therefore contains .drs/ANA-40.json, which triggers it. (3) In workers/instagram-oauth on a fresh local D1 state (rm -rf .wrangler first, the worktree may hold stale state): npm run validate exits 0 and its output lists 0001_init.sql and 0002_*.sql as applied; CI does not run this. (4) Migration backward compatibility: migrations/0001_init.sql is byte-identical to base; 0002 contains only ALTER TABLE instagram_tokens ADD COLUMN <name> INTEGER|TEXT statements without NOT NULL, DEFAULT, CHECK, trigger or UPDATE (no backfill); and the base worker's src/ and test/worker.test.mjs, run with a test D1 that applies every migrations/*.sql of the candidate in order, pass all tests (old code on new schema), with a recorded canary showing the same run fails for an incompatible 0002 (e.g. DROP COLUMN last_refresh_error). (5) Scope: git diff --name-only base...SHA lists only paths under workers/instagram-oauth/**, docs/** and .drs/**; workers/instagram-oauth/wrangler.toml is unchanged (no new trigger, binding or resource) and the required-settings list in configured() is unchanged (no new secret). (6) No secret and no real Instagram data in the diff: gitleaks git --log-opts=base..SHA --redact exits 0; on added lines of git diff base...SHA the count of matches for 'IG[A-Za-z0-9]{40,}|EAA[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}|access_token=[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}' is 0 and the count of 1784[0-9]{6,} numbers not starting with 178414000000 (the synthetic test ids) is 0; no real caption, media id, permalink or metric value. Stale evidence (a run on another SHA) is not evidence.

r4m.definition: The unchanged R2G candidate has: one independent DRS reviewer session (ROLE: DRS REVIEWER for ANA-40, not the implementing session) or the PO that verified the evidence on the exact candidate SHA; 0 open BLOCKS_CURRENT_GATE findings; PR mergeable with base at most 1 commit behind main; PR CI green on the exact SHA; and a PRE_MERGE reconcile of Jira, Confluence and GitHub without critical drift. MERGED is not Production Verified: AC10 is proven after merge and recorded in Jira ANA-40, in this order: PO approval of the exact merged SHA; remote migration 0002 applied and no migration pending; only then the worker deploy (new code needs the 0002 columns, old code runs on them unchanged); /admin/status for the existing token UNVERIFIED right after; CONNECTED with last_ok_source cron or refresh for anasavu after the next cron run; deployed worker version mapped to the merge commit.
